name: smwmusic-sonic-heroes-casino-park-re-arranged
title: Sonic Heroes - Casino Park (re-arranged)
description:
This sounds more like a sky song than a casino song. For me it has a strong Tails characterization.

Re-instrumentation is done to fit SNES sound limits; I've done my best to keep the most relevant pieces of drums; and also I've got rid of the different effects and drums patterns changing over iterations of the song, to keep it less busy. But in my book it fits well.

I could not have done that without my heavy use of musicalman's samples, so big thanks on that.

Requested by user OrangeBronzeDaisy.
